relevance_note: Single case report of a man with Tangier disease: 'Subsequent genetic testing identified a homozygous mutation in the ATP-binding Cassette Transporter A1 [ABCA1]'.
method_note: Hand-read the short image-challenge case (journal pre-proof); JSON assembled by a small script from hand-chosen spans. No tables. The ABCA1 variant is not described (only 'a homozygous mutation'), so the variant row has variant_original_string 'not reported'. Year taken from the citation line 'Gastroenterology (2021)' (accepted 15 December 2020). Age 33 recorded as age at last evaluation (age at admission); the paper gives no explicit age at diagnosis. 'Emergency gastroscopy was normal' is a normal examination as a whole and is recorded as such (abnormal emergency gastroscopy, excluded) without excluding anything more specific. The paper reports low 'apoprotein A [apoA]', not apoA-I, so the checklist item 'low apolipoprotein A-I' is left not reported. Hepatomegaly is mentioned only in general disease description ('hepatosplenomegaly'), not for this patient. Intestinal mucosal lipid deposits marked observed from the patient's mucosal foamy-macrophage infiltration plus the paper's statement that foamy macrophages contain lipid material. No contradictions found.
